name: CannonBeemon
main_effect:
[Security] [Opponent's Turn] All of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] For each of your face up security cards, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
